headline: Emergency Response Officer
summary: Construction safety officer of five years who moved into emergency response for a resort and port company in Bohol. I plan and lead emergency response, keep people safe during incidents, look after health and safety programs and protective equipment, and train staff and guests in drills.

experience.title: Emergency Response Officer
experience.employer: Bohol Island Ports and Resorts Group
experience.paragraph: Responsible for emergency preparedness across a ferry terminal and two resorts.
bullets: Lead the emergency response team for fire, earthquake, storm-surge and medical incidents.
Plan evacuation routes and run quarterly drills for staff and guests.
Manage protective equipment, fire extinguishers and rescue gear and inspect them monthly.
Run health and safety briefings for new staff and contractors.

experience.title: Construction Safety Officer
experience.paragraph: Covered safety on mid-rise hotel and commercial construction projects.
bullets: Inspected sites daily and stopped unsafe work.
Enforced use of harnesses, helmets and other protective equipment.
Ran toolbox talks and kept safety records for inspections.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
